decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting narratives regarding the identity of Bernard John Croft's spouse. Document 1 (D1) describes a recent marriage between Bernard John Croft and Ville Muranen, explicitly referring to Muranen as 'his new husband' (D1S4) and stating they 'tied the knot' (D1S2). Document 2 (D2) describes a historical or alternative narrative where Bernard John Croft married Janet Madeleine Streader, noting they 'defy the conventions... to forge a bond that would last a lifetime' (D2S3) and describing their marriage as a 'union of two individuals' (D2S17). Per the instruction to 'Keep supported alternate referents rather than one familiar winner' and acknowledging that 'Different artists can legitimately release works with an identical title; different people can have distinct dates' (implying distinct entities or timelines can share names), both answers are retained as they are directly supported by the respective source texts without evidence to invalidate one in favor of the other within the provided context.
